mapper.select: SELECT pioi.id, pioi.shipping_order_item_id, pioi.purchase_order_id, po.order_no AS purchase_order_no, pioi.purchase_order_item_id, pioi.sku_code, pioi.expected_quantity, pioi.actual_quantity, pioi.expected_quality, (pioi.expected_quantity - pioi.actual_quantity) AS short_quantity, pioi.remark FROM wms_purchase_inbound_order_item pioi LEFT JOIN wms_purchase_order po ON pioi.purchase_order_id = po.id WHERE pioi.inbound_order_id = #{inboundOrderId} ORDER BY pioi.id ASC
